title: Laundry Day, But Make It Pink
description: A pink laundry room reset: a pink gingham laundry basket, two pink ribbed soap dispensers, pink velvet hangers, a rose gold lint roller, pink mesh wash bags and a pink handheld steamer.
intro: Laundry day is not going anywhere, so it might as well look good. A pink gingham basket, a row of velvet hangers and a little steamer that does the ironing for you. Six finds, one Amazon list.

approval.source: Jodie sent the final images in chat and asked for the rest of the system to be finished and scheduled
approval.scope: Publish this Lifestyle article and its supplied images

sections.heading: The basket sets the tone
paragraphs: A pink gingham laundry basket with leather handles is the one piece that makes the whole corner feel planned. Two pink ribbed soap dispensers with black pumps sit by the machines for detergent and softener.

sections.heading: Hang it, bag it, steam it
paragraphs: Fifty pink velvet hangers keep every cardigan in its place and stop things slipping off. Pink mesh wash bags look after the delicates, and a pink handheld steamer smooths a wrinkled shirt in minutes.

sections.heading: A little lint roller for the last pass
paragraphs: A rose gold retractable lint roller lives on the counter for the final check before you walk out the door.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The six finds are the gingham laundry basket, the two soap dispensers, the velvet hangers, the lint roller, the wash bags and the steamer. The washers, shelves, plants, lamp, towels, clothes, rug and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, colour and size before you buy.
